Delimited array convenience is deferred under whm-api-client-8x0.28.7.

evidence.note: Complete pinned operation as webProsAuthCallback. Preserve canonical whm1:360Monitoring/webpros_auth_callback and all optional nonnullable formal fields, required nonnull known-object root, version 11.132 and normal WHM Flag outcome. Formal POST with required application/x-www-form-urlencoded json body field.
Required sensitive plain-string schema and full callback JSON prose. Form field stays body-only; preserve bytes without client JSON validation. Prose keys do not establish a formal nested schema.

notes.text: Send required JSON text in the single body-only json form field. Its prose requires code/state; optional session_id applies only when the request has no session, and the request session takes precedence. Legacy verifier is accepted but ignored and documented for later removal; PKCE verifier stays server-side.

State is validated before external exchange. Matching state is consumed whether exchange succeeds or fails; unknown or other-session state consumes nothing. A retry requires a caller-selected new flow. The server stores the token bundle; this response returns only email/expiry summary, never access/refresh tokens. token_unusable may mean a token was stored but is unusable: success is not an all-or-nothing or rollback guarantee.

The sensitive json argument is a raw string, not a complete application/json request body. Form encode it exactly once, preserving whitespace, unknown keys, scalar/invalid JSON strings and all bytes for server validation. No automatic JSON serialization, nested schema or per-key convenience; the prose-schema companion remains deferred under whm-api-client-8x0.1.22. Never put this value in URL query data or retry the callback implicitly.
Source formally requires body-only POST.
